title: The Missing Central Limit Theorems for Local Functionals of Berry's Random Wave Model
summary: Central Limit Theorems for integrals of third degree Hermite polynomials of Berry's random wave model on increasingly large domains are proved in dimensions 2 and 3. These were the missing cases for a complete description of limit theorems for integral functionals of monochromatic random waves based on the Wiener chaos decomposition.
